claims: The AEW Revolution 2026 Zero Hour pre-show took place on March 15, 2026.
The AEW Revolution 2026 Zero Hour pre-show took place at the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles, CA.
The AEW Revolution 2026 Zero Hour pre-show featured a 21-man Blackjack Battle Royal for the National Championship.
The AEW Revolution 2026 Zero Hour pre-show featured a TBS Title match.
The AEW Revolution 2026 Zero Hour pre-show featured the return of Luchasaurus, who drove a bus to drop off Jack Perry, according to Fightful and Wikipedia.
The 21-Man Blackjack Battle Royal for the National Championship featured Ricochet (c) and Tommaso Ciampa, according to CBS Sports.
The TBS Championship Match was Willow Nightingale (c) vs. Lena Kross, as reported by Fightful and YouTube.
Willow Nightingale retained the TBS Championship, as reported by Fightful and YouTube.
Boom & Doom (A.J. & Q.T. Marshall) vs. The Infantry (Capt. Shawn Dean & Carlie Bravo).
Luchasaurus appeared during the pre-show to drop off Jack Perry, notes Fightful.
Luchasaurus's appearance was his first since December 2025, notes Fightful.
The event date was Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The event location was Crypto.com Arena, Los Angeles, California.
The event was broadcast at 7 p.m. ET on YouTube, TNT, and HBO Max.
